title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
summary: Find the area of the largest rectangle that fits inside a histogram of unit-width bars.

tests.explain: The bars of height 4 and 5 are side by side: a rectangle 2 wide and 4 tall has area 8.
All bars are equal, so the whole histogram is one 3 × 3 rectangle.
The 0 bar splits the histogram. Each side can only make a 1 × 2 rectangle.

hints: The best rectangle has the height of some bar i. How far can a rectangle of exactly that height stretch to the left and to the right?
It stretches until the first strictly shorter bar on each side. A stack of indices with increasing heights finds both of those bars in one pass.

When bar i is shorter than the bar on top, pop the top: i is its right limit and the new top of the stack is its left limit, so its width is i - newTop - 1. A final bar of height 0 flushes whatever is left.

complexity.time: O(n): every bar is pushed once and popped once
